results.title: Density of boundary entropy spectra for surface groups
results.summary: Boundary entropy spectra are dense throughout the full entropy range for every closed orientable surface group of genus at least two and every finitely supported semigroup-generating measure. Faithful arithmetic projective representations give essentially free approximants with dense image and full-dimensional stationary measures. For the uniform genus-two walk, the paper gives generic exact realization and the interval [0, ½ log 3], with applications to coordinate products and boundary-lattice limits. Full realization for the original walk remains unresolved.

results.title: Invariant random C*-subalgebras of products of hyperbolic groups
results.summary: An extension of boomerang subalgebra rigidity to finite products of torsion-free nonamenable hyperbolic groups and countable restricted direct sums. The proposed classification identifies every invariant random C*-subalgebra with a unique invariant random subgroup. The proof combines selective tensor averaging, coordinatewise centering, and mixed Fourier-coefficient extraction.

results.title: Countable strongly Choquet–Deny groups are precisely the virtually FC groups
results.summary: A note extending the finitely generated classification of Dantas and Doucha to countable groups: the strongly Choquet–Deny groups are precisely the virtually FC groups, with the same characterization for the positive condition. The argument adapts their renorming criterion and analytic obstruction, adding finite conjugacy averaging and a sequence construction when the FC-center has infinite index.

results.title: Hyperrigidity in low dimensions and a dimension-33 counterexample
results.summary: Version 2 presents hyperrigidity for every compact convex subset of R3 with closed extreme boundary, retains the explicit affine-dimension-33 counterexample, and establishes the range 4 ≤ d_min ≤ 33. The revised argument uses a dilation replacement and bounded Borel endpoint interpolation, avoiding disintegration. Includes further construction obstructions and a finite-POVM criterion.

results.title: Kirchberg algebras as full amalgams of stably finite algebras
results.summary: A proposed decomposition of unital Kirchberg algebras as full amalgamated free products of stably finite algebras. The companion Lean development is conditional on external analytic interfaces.

results.title: Cubic lower bounds for conjugacy separation in nilpotent groups
results.summary: A construction proposing cubic lower bounds, in Hirsch length, for conjugacy separability growth in torsion-free finitely generated nilpotent groups, with a companion Lean formalization of the lower-bound construction.

results.title: Rapid Decay and C*-Simplicity: A Supplementary Sunflower Proof
results.summary: A supplementary AI-assisted sunflower proof relating rapid decay, the amenable radical, and C*-simplicity, with an extension to sub-rapid decay.
